belief_update: I believe that if my students see me struggling, they'll stop respecting me as a teacher. I think people would treat me differently if they knew I had anxiety, maybe even think I'm not as strong as I need to be. I hide it all the time at school because I can't risk anyone seeing weakness. At home, I sometimes let it slip, but I quickly pull back. I don't tell anyone the whole truth because I'm afraid it would make me seem less capable. I don't know if it's who I am or just something temporary, but I keep it hidden anyway. I don't let anyone see how much it affects me, not even myself.
